verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs show built-in event-triggered automation: deploys run on every push and each PR gets a preview URL. Community comments mention automated builds and forms/webhooks. There is no evidence of a general facility where users define their own event→action rules. missing for 10: user-definable trigger/rule configuration, documented catalog of events and actions, registrable outbound event hooks, first-party docs beyond the fixed push-to-deploy behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
The GitHub/Slack integration, automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great.
